contentList.content: Homeless Californian

Hardened by the concrete jungles of San Francisco and Los Angeles, the Homeless Californian channels makeshift biological warfare, erratic street fury, and the gravity-defying equilibrium of the legendary Fent Lean.
Tenderloin Biohazard
Master of chemical concoctions and sidewalk biohazards. Amplifies the potency of toxic clouds, explosive biological payloads, and turns environmental hazards into personal restoration.
Venice Boardwalk Brawler
A ferocious close-quarters pugilist specializing in improvised shivs, reckless flurries, and chaotic shopping cart charges.
BART Platform Menace
An erratic street phantom who slips through turnstiles and spatial dimensions, unleashing ear-piercing 3 AM screeches to disorient and terrorize foes.
Sling Poop
Hurl a handful of raw biological waste at a target. Deals 1d6 Bludgeoning + 1d4 Poison damage, coats the ground in a repulsive slick, and inflicts Fecal Stench.
Sling Chunky Poop
Hurl a dense, fermented biological projectile with devastating force. Deals 2d6 Bludgeoning + 2d6 Poison damage, spreading an expanded slick and inflicting severe Fecal Stench.
Sling Fentanyl
Launch a concentrated chemical dose at an enemy. Deals 1d4 Psychic damage, spawns a toxic narcotic haze, and forces a DC Constitution Saving Throw or the target is paralyzed in Fent Stupor.
Mass Fentanyl Contraband
Scatter an entire contraband brick across a wide area. Creates an expansive narcotic fog that numbs, slows, and incapacitates all caught within.
Fent Lean

Enter a state of gravity-defying postural transcendence. You bend backward at an impossible 45-degree angle. While leaning, you gain Resistance to all damage types, Advantage on Constitution and Dexterity saving throws, and +2 Armour Class, but your movement speed is reduced to zero. Can snap out at any time as a Free Action.
Snap Out of Lean
Instantly snap your spine back upright with a terrifying pop. Restores your mobility immediately. Costs no Action or Bonus Action.
Sidewalk Scramble
Scurry frantically across broken glass and hazardous surfaces as a Bonus Action. Increases movement speed, stacks with Dash, and grants immunity to difficult terrain and slipping for 2 turns.
Aggressive Panhandling

Shake a rusty cup aggressively at all nearby enemies within 6m. Forces a DC Wisdom Saving Throw: failing creatures must drop 2d6 gold on the ground and suffer Disadvantage on Attack Rolls for 2 turns from sheer awkwardness.
Feral Screech
Unleash an unhinged, ear-splitting 3 AM psychotic shriek. All enemies within a 9m cone suffer 3d6 Thunder damage and must make a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Frightened for 2 turns.
Pitch Tent Encampment
Erect a fortified, tarp-and-shopping-cart shantytown bunker on the battlefield. Provides Half-Cover (+2 AC and saving throws) to all allies inside and generates an aura of biological discouragement.
Biohazard Bomb
Lob a pressurized five-gallon bucket of aged, fermented street slop. Explodes in a 5m radius dealing 4d6 Poison + 2d6 Acid damage and creating persistent toxic fumes.
Broken 40oz Shank
Drive a jagged malt liquor bottleneck into vital organs. Deals 2d4 Piercing + 1d6 Slashing damage and inflicts deep Bleeding.
Shopping Cart Charge
Mount a rattling grocery cart packed with scrap metal and careen headfirst into enemy ranks. Deals 3d6 Bludgeoning damage, knocks all creatures in your path Prone, and travels up to 9 meters.
Turnstile Hop
Slip between the spatial fabric of reality just like hopping a transit barrier. Teleport up to 18 meters as a Bonus Action, leaving behind a brief burst of confusing screeching.
Fecal Stench
Overwhelmed by nauseating biological stench. Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and takes 1d4 Poison damage per turn.
Fent Stupor
Incapacitated and paralyzed in an unresponsive narcotic daze. Cannot move or take actions.
Fent Lean
Locked in supreme postural equilibrium. Resistant to all damage, +2 AC, Advantage on DEX and CON saves, but Movement Speed is 0.
Sidewalk Scramble
Movement speed increased by 3m. Immune to difficult terrain, grease, and surface slipping.
Socially Shamed
Deeply rattled by persistent street solicitation. Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Sidewalk Immunity
Years of dumpster exposure have forged an impenetrable immune system. Immune to Disease and Poisoned, and resistant to Poison damage.
Restorative Stupor
While locked in the Fent Lean, your slowed metabolic rate knits wounds back together, restoring 2d6 Hit Points at the start of every turn.
Baffling Retaliation
While in Fent Lean, melee attackers attempting to strike your bewildering posture strike bone-jarring equilibrium, suffering 1d10 Psychic damage.
Proposition 47

Petty theft under 950 gold is completely decriminalized. Whenever you strike an enemy with a melee attack, you snatch a Stolen Patagonia Vest (+1 AC, +1d4 damage) for 2 turns. Authorities will apologize for profiling you.
Stolen Patagonia Vest
Warm, fleece-lined, and acquired without prosecution. Grants +1 Armour Class and adds 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to weapon strikes.
Pocket Lint Buffet
Rummaging through the coats of foes marinating in your biological weaponry grants sustenance. Dealing damage to a creature afflicted with Fecal Stench restores 1d6 Temporary Hit Points.
Eviction Notice

Serve a foe with an immediate lease termination. The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw or fall into crushing financial ruin with Rent Hike: losing -2 AC (cannot afford armor), -3m Movement, and taking 2d4 Psychic damage at the start of each turn from Bay Area cost of living.
Rent Hike
Crushed by runaway housing costs. Suffers -2 AC, -3m Movement, and takes 2d4 Psychic damage at the start of each turn.
Tenderloin Biohazard Aura
An unbearable 3-meter miasma radiating from your person. Enemies entering or starting their turn within range must make a Constitution save or contract Fecal Stench.
Encampment Sweep Survival Instinct
When the municipal cleanup crew drops you below 50% Hit Points, your body reflexively collapses into Fent Lean as an emergency damage-resistant bunker once per combat.
Sweep Fatigue
Your survival reflexes need time to reset.
Call 311 (On Hold)
Subject all enemies in a 9m radius to the agonizing purgatory of municipal hold music. Enemies lose their Reaction and Bonus Action, and have their movement halved for 3 turns.
On Hold (311)
Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold. Cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and Movement Speed is halved.
Californian

Hailing from the Golden State, Californians possess an uncanny resilience shaped by natural disasters, gridlock traffic, and perpetual microclimates. Whether meditating on a Malibu beach or pitching a seed-stage venture in a coffee shop, they navigate Faerûn with effortless chill and passive aggression.
Beachborn (SoCal)
Sun-drenched coastal dwellers who surf metaphysical waves. Radiant resistance, supreme mobility, and the innate ability to 'Hang Ten' across treacherous surfaces.
Siliconite (NorCal)
Disruptive visionaries fortified by microdosed mushroom tea and quarterly pitch decks. Channels psychic energy to disrupt hostile thought patterns and optimize output.
Inland Emperor (The Valley)
Forged in extreme heatwaves, agricultural dust, and unending highway commutes. Virtually immune to toxic air, burning conditions, and high-temperature environments.
California Identity & Gender Expression
Select your spiritual California identity and pronoun archetype. Each comes with bespoke perks, cultural flair, and cosmic validation.
Dude (Dude / Dude / Dudeself)

A timeless, universal California vibration. You greet gods, goblins, and dragons alike as 'dude'. You gain +1 to Persuasion checks, and have Advantage on Saving Throws against intoxication, fear, and exhaustion.
Founder (Founder / Disrupter / Unicorn)
You operate in perpetual stealth mode. Treating every battle as a Series-A pitch, you gain +2 to Initiative and Advantage on Deception checks when bluffing.
Oat (Oat / Almond / Lactose-Free)
Completely organic, non-GMO, and free of inflammatory systemic toxins. You are completely immune to the Poisoned condition.
Self-Actualized (Aura / High-Frequency / Elevated)
Your chakras are aligned to the exact resonant frequency of Sedona crystals. At the start of combat, you automatically manifest 5 Temporary Hit Points.
The Algorithm (Optimized / Scaled / Series-A)
You have surrendered all bodily autonomy to predictive machine learning models. You gain a +1 bonus to all Saving Throws as incoming attacks are forecasted in real-time.
Touch Grass

Touch a foe and force them to disconnect from online discourse. Deals 1d8 Psychic damage, immediately terminates any active Rage, Frenzy, or Enraged condition, and inflicts Existential Daze (Disadvantage on Attack Rolls for 2 turns).
Avocado Toast
Nourish yourself with artisanal sourdough topped with mashed Hass avocado and flaky sea salt. Restores 1d6 + CON modifier Hit Points and grants 5 Temporary Hit Points.
Hang Ten
Catch the cosmic Pacific swell. Increases movement speed by 3m and grants immunity to difficult terrain and slipping on ice or grease for 2 turns.
Vibe Check
Subject a target's consciousness to a brutal seed-stage vibe check. Target must succeed a DC Wisdom saving throw or break concentration and suffer Existential Dread.
Earthquake Sense
Born on the San Andreas Fault, you possess impeccable footing. Advantage on Saving Throws against falling Prone or knockdowns.
405 Commute Veteran
Decades spent idling on the I-405 freeway have made you immune to gridlock. You cannot be Slowed or Restrained.
Smog Lungs
Central Valley dust and Los Angeles smog have turned your respiratory system into an industrial air filter. Advantage on saving throws against Poison and Disease.
Heat Index Mastery
Triple-digit Palm Springs heat is merely room temperature to you. Immune to Burning condition.
Siliconite Synergy
Cross-functional synergy allows you to optimize output. Once per turn, dealing weapon damage deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.
Existential Daze
Disconnected from rage by reality. Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Avocado Bliss
Fortified by artisanal healthy fats. Grants Temporary Hit Points.
Hang Ten
Surfing metaphysical waves. +3m Movement Speed and immune to slipping or difficult terrain.
Vibe Checked
Concentration broken and mind disrupted by venture capital reality.
